with flame of sparks of fire
Rigveda-reciter, by them unrewardable, among costly furnishings of austerity and glory
loving words of the far-stepping one
even of the lords of speech
said, "do not be shaken in speech"
in the cord of speech, a great rope
words of those who do not know that
for power of word and meaning
by the ignorant, many ways thus
desires what does not exist as if in the Self
(they) desire like Uma's lord to dispel the Self's darkness
should desire the root of the foot
very well thus the two said, congratulating the brahmana
very well, I wish to marry the one not given
took the arrow with bow raised
with a voice full of love, like a son
by drying the body with wind, water, leaves
by fierce austerities accumulated long by wind, water, leaves
with turbans waving in wind, flames, armour and ornaments
of two like the Self, deceivers
dust-grey with dust raised by storm
out of affection, welfare of world
Badarayani, all senses carried off by memory of the Endless
with instruments, songs, brahmin mantra reciters
made with instruments, songs, brahmin mantra reciters
with instruments, songs, brahmin mantra reciters
oppressed by the rain of weapons
of the two Vanaras, restraint, Lord
pleasure-ground blocked by the army of monkey chiefs
pleasure-ground, gate, arch, hall, balcony blocked by the army of monkey chiefs
to be informed to the witness of all
by left fingernails, hair, sidelong glances
in the form of the Dwarf incarnation
like wind with dust of clouds
like wind in a hole, the Lord
wind, fire, sun, water, speech, Self
by qualities of wind, fire, water, earth
by qualities of wind, fire, water, earth, by comings and goings of seasonal qualities
wind, sky, fire, water, earth, three worlds
or one should worship in the image
praising him with marks of Indra-slayer
or the purpose, to you here
of these two boys among men
not very cruel to children friends
though a child, of unclouded mind
even in childhood, eleven kinds because of lack of fullness
or at the end of hundreds of years
living beings inclined to eating, drinking, clothing, bathing, sexual union
the two went wishing to dwell
resounding with fighting over the perfumed object
touching winds with very holy fragrance of Vasudeva's body-ointment
with clothes, food, drink, bed, sexual union, bath, ornaments
as if clothes from fear of enemy
honoured with clothes, ornaments, utensils and so on
as soon as it came out
arms extended, embraces, terrible thighs, undone waistband, touching breasts, jests, nail marks
by the arms of the Ashvins
by two arms, heart agitated with longing
arrangement of arm, shoulder, neck, face and other limbs
dragging the husband of a servant-girl, Ajamila, from the heart
various things made by the merging of imagined good and bad
scented with blooming kunda and mandara, bees
of the two falling from Vaikuntha, their intellect lost
from the modified, impelled by the Lord's power
from the modified, enhanced by rajas and sattva
playing in the ocean of nectar
pride of kings and gods gone
whose fear of the Sudarshana is gone
the two whose pride has gone
whose affection for the Self's course is gone
with melting nectar of sweet speech
hair thrilled, shown by pure streaming tears
